decided_in: docs/DECISIONS.md, 'T4.6 - Gates for choosing E12's model, fixed before their runs' (2026-11-04); how they are computed: 'T4.6 - Gate runs and the gates stage'

num_workers.note: All seven gate runs use 4 loader workers, the count E4 used, so the augmentation draws depend on the same count everywhere in G2. Any other count is refused. The count is written to every record. A resume must use the count the run started with.

g1.note: min_gain is half of the +0.289 PlantDoc macro-F1 gain of the first E12 held-out run. The gain is the trimmed run minus E4's held-out run, on the same 610 cleaned PlantDoc field_dev rows. Sick-only macro-F1 and healthy accuracy are reported, not gated (DECISIONS).

g2.seed_reason: E4 and E12's first runs used seed 0 (configs/e4.json seed; configs/e4.json rules do not say otherwise), so the second seed is seed + 1.

g3.note: A confident sick-called-healthy answer is a photo whose true class is a sick class, whose calibrated top probability is at or above that model's own E5 abstain_threshold, and whose top class is any healthy class. Counted on the cleaned field_dev rows of the seen-source E12 record (the same photos for both models). E12 passes when its count is not above E4's.

sick_only: Rows whose true class is a sick class; macro-F1 over those classes (a sick photo called healthy counts as wrong, a healthy photo called sick is not in these rows). Healthy accuracy: the share of rows whose true class is a healthy class that get exactly that class. Intervals resample near-duplicate groups as check_run does.

runs.name: heldout_plantdoc_extra_trim
runs.change: the first E12 PlantDoc held-out run with the extras at DINOv2 cosine 0.75 or above to PlantDoc's evaluated or training photos also removed

limits: Development numbers on field_dev, as in configs/e12.json. field_test is never read.
Seed 1 changes the lab photos the cap keeps as well as the weights' start and the sample order; E4 and E12 on the same seed share them, so each pair stays comparable.
Two seeds are still few: the intervals resample photos, not training noise, and the gate looks at a second seed's point estimate and interval only.
